item.title: Chicago Auto Show 2026 at McCormick Place, Feb. 7-16: Hours, ticket prices and more
item.description: The Chicago Automobile Trade Association (CATA), producer of the Chicago Auto Show, released the dates and plans for the 2026 event, which will be held Feb. 7-16 at McCormick Place.

item.title: Anti-ICE protests held in Chicago area 1 month after fatal shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis
item.description: Saturday marked one month since the killing of Renee Good in Minneapolis, Minnesota. She is one of several people who have been shot by federal agents.

item.title: Chicago man in ICE detention for months is sole guardian of younger siblings, demonstrators say
item.description: Demonstrators say 22-year-old Federico Alcantar, the sole guardian of his two younger siblings, has been in ICE detention for months after being arrested allegedly at gunpoint during a traffic stop by immigration agents who were looking for someone else.

item.title: Chicago Auto Show 2026 officially opens to public at McCormick Place on Saturday
item.description: The longest-running auto show in America is back, in its 118th year!

item.title: ABC7 Presents Chicago Auto Show 2026
item.description: The 2026 Chicago Auto Show returns to McCormick Place and runs through February 17. ABC7's Ryan Chiaverini, Ravi Baichwal, Tracy Butler and Diane Pathieu checked out the latest cars, trucks, SUVs and more the show has to offer.

item.title: Chicago police investigating several vehicle break-ins in Hyde Park
item.description: Nearly 30 cars were broken into in one area on the city's South Side overnight. Chicago police are investigating.

item.title: 1 killed in police-involved shooting in Waukegan, officials say
item.description: A person was killed in a police-involved shooting Saturday in the north suburbs, officials said.

item.title: New water main break in Dixmoor repaired, but 2nd break reported nearby, village officials say
item.description: A second water main break was reported Saturday after another break that impacted dozens of homes in south suburban Dixmoor was repaired, village officials said.

item.title: Mother, boyfriend charged with murder of 8-year-old boy in Round Lake Beach, police say
item.description: A mother and her boyfriend are charged with murder and child endangerment in the death of her 8-year-old son, who appeared malnourished and had bruising on his body, in the north suburbs, police said.

item.title: 2 surfers missing off coast of Santa Cruz, California, US Coast Guard says
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard is searching for two missing surfers in California. The Coast Guard received a report from bystanders of the surfers in the water yelling for help approximately 200 yards offshore.
